name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Descend until the dumbbells reach mid-shin or you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes to stand.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: A beginner dumbbell hinge-pattern exercise for the glutes. Dumbbell Deadlift builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
